# Gelabber v0.8.7

Integrated through #406–#417 into `v0.8` and the version PR into `main`.

A release of polish after customer feedback: calmer text, an overview that
shows what is new, one bottom strip, chat pictures in their own size, and a
new set of call sounds. Going live no longer writes into the chat. No
database migration, no `.env`, `compose.yaml` or `Caddyfile` changes beyond
the image pins.

## Going live

- **No chat message anymore (#407).** The API no longer posts "X ist live
  in Y." into the server's oldest text channel. Messages already stored
  still show in the history.
- **A notice without a chat row (#410).** People who are not in that voice
  channel get an in-app popup, a desktop notification and a sound when
  someone actually goes live (not on reconnect or for Lives already
  running). It follows the server's notification setting (only at "Alle
  Nachrichten", not when muted) and the existing popup, desktop and sound
  switches; at most one notice per person and channel within 10 minutes.
  A click opens the voice channel without joining it.

## Call sounds

- **Signatur (#411).** The plain sine beeps are replaced by a set
  synthesized in the client, original and without audio files. Every event
  has its own sound: joining and leaving (you and others), mute and
  deafen, someone else muting, a Live starting and ending (in the call and
  as the notice above), camera on and off, and new messages.
- New switch "Töne, wenn andere sich stumm schalten", on by default. While
  deafened, other people's sounds stay silent; your own buttons still
  answer.

## Interface

- **Overview (#413).** Server name and one line of facts ("4 Mitglieder ·
  2 im Sprachkanal") instead of a greeting; the voice channel with a
  "Verbunden" chip and fixed tiles; below it "Ungelesen": only channels with
  new messages, each with its latest message, time and badge. The member
  list no longer repeats "Online"/"Offline" under every name.
- **One bottom strip (#412).** The user panel and the call bar share
  height, colour and top edge (they were 7 px apart). All call bar buttons
  have one height and radius; a camera that is on is tinted instead of a
  solid block.
- **Text (#414, #417).** About 120 texts are shorter and neutral; the app
  says "Sprachkanal" everywhere, "Beitreten", "Inhaber", "Server".
- **Composer placeholder (#406).** "Nachricht an …" now reads as a hint,
  not as typed text.
- **Chat pictures (#408).** A single picture gets a box in its own shape and
  is never enlarged; a small, wide screenshot no longer sits in a large
  empty frame.

## Tests

- The desktop loopback test no longer fails when libwebrtc holds back
  simulcast layers for bandwidth on a busy CI runner; a layer that was sent
  but not received still fails (#409, #416).

## Upgrade notes

- Image pins `GELABBER_{API,WEB,MEDIA}_IMAGE` move together to `v0.8.7`.
  Update API and web together: a new web with an old API shows both the
  chat line and the new notice for a Live start.
- Rollback: the v0.8.6 image set, all three together. The database is
  unchanged.
- The desktop app loads the interface from the server, so it gets the new
  interface and sounds without an app update.
- **Desktop, Windows:** the installer and `latest.json` are attached to this
  release; older apps offer the update.
- **Desktop, Linux (Arch):** update from the pacman repository.

## Open

- The live notice, the sounds and the bottom strip were checked in Chromium
  and unit tests, not yet in the desktop app's WebKit or in a live call.
- "Jemand schaut deinen Stream" has a sound but is not wired: the client
  does not learn who watches a Live without a server change.
- An edited latest message shows in "Ungelesen" only after about 30 seconds.
